title.en: OpenAI limits GPT-6 Cyber access to approved security customers
title.zhHans: OpenAI 将 GPT-6 Cyber 限定向获批安全客户开放

searchSummary.en: OpenAI published GPT-6 Cyber’s system card on November 5 and restricted access through its approved Daybreak Red program.
searchSummary.zhHans: OpenAI 于 11 月 5 日发布 GPT-6 Cyber 系统卡，并通过须经批准的 Daybreak Red 项目限制访问。

summary.en: OpenAI’s system card dated November 5 describes GPT-6 Cyber as a specialized model for authorized security work, with access restricted through Daybreak Red. Its API documentation requires organization approval; Reuters reported initial access for a small set of vetted customers. OpenAI itself classified the model Critical for cybersecurity under its own framework. The full OpenAI announcement returned HTTP 403, and vendor-reported vulnerability totals or safety outcomes are not independently validated here.
summary.zhHans: OpenAI 日期为 11 月 5 日的系统卡将 GPT-6 Cyber 描述为面向授权安全工作的专用模型，访问限于 Daybreak Red。其 API 文档要求组织预先获批；路透社报道初期仅向少量经审核客户开放。OpenAI 按其自身框架将模型网络安全能力归为“Critical”。完整公告直接获取返回 HTTP 403；本轮未独立核实厂商所报漏洞数量或安全效果。

narrative.en: This node records restricted deployment and documentation, not universal API access, field exploitation, independently established safety or a novel incident. Reuters’ figures relay OpenAI and must not be counted as separate testing.
narrative.zhHans: 本节点记录的是受限部署及文档发布，并非 API 普遍开放、实际攻击、已独立证实安全性或发生新事件。路透社转述的数字仍源于 OpenAI，不能计作第二份测试。

text.en: OpenAI’s November 5 system card and API listing restrict GPT-6 Cyber to approved Daybreak Red organizations; Reuters reported limited initial access.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 11 月 5 日的系统卡和 API 页面将 GPT-6 Cyber 限定向获批 Daybreak Red 组织开放；路透社报道初期访问范围有限。

text.en: OpenAI internally rates the model Critical in cybersecurity; the rating is not an independent capability or safety verification.
text.zhHans: OpenAI 内部将该模型的网络安全能力评级为“Critical”；这不是独立的能力或安全验证。
